title: Europe's new robotics unicorn: Germany's RobCo hits $1B valuation
summary: German robotics startup RobCo has reached a $1B valuation, becoming Europe's newest robotics unicorn. The company builds modular, AI-driven industrial robots aimed at automating manufacturing tasks for small and mid-sized businesses. The news, discussed on Hacker News with 272 points and 234 comments, highlights growing investor interest in practical robotics automation in Europe.
